items.consequence_if_unresolved: S08 must decide a compatibility boundary before exact non-JSON artifacts and acquisition provenance can be represented.
items.reason_for_deferral: decide whether v1 remains behind an outer envelope or follows an explicit versioned path
items.title: ArtifactSnapshot media and envelope gap

items.consequence_if_unresolved: S07 cannot identify bounded evidence without choosing revision-qualified range composition and digest linkage.
items.reason_for_deferral: decide locator granularity and range semantics
items.title: SourceLocator byte-range ambiguity

items.consequence_if_unresolved: S07 must define typed parent-scoped discussion identities before bounded evidence can reference them.
items.reason_for_deferral: decide typed discussion identities and parent scope
items.title: SourceLocator discussion-surface gap

items.consequence_if_unresolved: The future evidence carrier must retain this boundary without turning current-visible observations into a complete-history claim.
items.reason_for_deferral: decide a structured bounded-surface and unknown-history representation
items.title: Current-visible provider surface only

items.consequence_if_unresolved: This is an evidentiary unknown to preserve, not an authorization to reacquire or reconstruct history.
items.reason_for_deferral: separately authorized historical evidence
items.title: Discussion edit and deletion history unknown

items.consequence_if_unresolved: The unknown must not be replaced with the repository's current default branch.
items.reason_for_deferral: separately authorized historical ref evidence
items.title: Historical default branch unknown

items.consequence_if_unresolved: S06 cannot infer repository identity from the surviving immutable head SHA or deleted ref.
items.reason_for_deferral: new evidence that directly identifies the historical head repository
items.title: Original head repository identity unknown

items.consequence_if_unresolved: The public case cannot support private-source completeness claims and no private acquisition is authorized.
items.reason_for_deferral: separately authorized private-source evidence
items.title: Private and permission-hidden records unknown

items.consequence_if_unresolved: Identity confusion follows if aliases or refs are treated as immutable object identity.
items.reason_for_deferral: decide stable identity plus timed alias and ref observations
items.title: Mutable aliases and ref observations

items.consequence_if_unresolved: Collapsing the two revisions would corrupt topology and later causal interpretation.
items.reason_for_deferral: decide explicit revision roles and ordered-parent semantics
items.title: Recorded base differs from merge first parent

items.consequence_if_unresolved: One public github.com case cannot justify a universal provider, private-source, or GitHub Enterprise contract.
items.reason_for_deferral: additional authorized provider and private-source evidence
items.title: No universal private or GHE claims

items.consequence_if_unresolved: Future provenance must preserve observation and publication timing instead of silently backdating C01.
items.reason_for_deferral: decide observation and publication provenance vocabulary
items.title: Supplemental observations postdate original S04

items.consequence_if_unresolved: Fresh public observations remain bounded and cannot prove complete historical attribution.
items.reason_for_deferral: separately authorized historical attribution evidence
items.title: Complete historical actor and review state not proven

items.consequence_if_unresolved: A future identity contract must preserve observed null separately from omitted, unavailable, and unknown.
items.reason_for_deferral: decide actor identity and explicit missing-state vocabulary
items.title: Issue timeline actor observed null

items.consequence_if_unresolved: Authority-derived URLs must not be mislabeled as provider-returned evidence.
items.reason_for_deferral: decide URL authority, construction, and observation provenance
items.title: Canonical URLs not provider observed

items.consequence_if_unresolved: A compatibility carrier must add later observations without mutating or pretending to repair S04.
items.reason_for_deferral: decide an append-only addendum and supersession boundary
items.title: Original S04 actor and reviewer fields remain absent

items.consequence_if_unresolved: Future evidence must preserve explicit non-replayability without fabricating cleaned transient fields.
items.reason_for_deferral: decide structured omission and retained-source boundaries
items.title: Intentionally omitted original values are not replayable

items.consequence_if_unresolved: The correct state is an unverified hypothesis rather than a product defect cause or missing implementation.
items.reason_for_deferral: direct causal evidence and later claim-review design
items.title: Stale-cache causation unverified

items.consequence_if_unresolved: The case vocabulary is sufficient for literal testing but insufficient to establish a universal production relationship schema.
items.reason_for_deferral: additional cases and explicit claim and relationship design
items.title: Case relationship vocabulary provisional

items.consequence_if_unresolved: S08 must decide how evidence, relationships, and provenance coexist with current provisional models before compatibility work proceeds.
items.reason_for_deferral: complete S07 identity decisions and decide the S08 evidence boundary
items.title: Current internal models cannot represent full case

items.consequence_if_unresolved: One case cannot calibrate a confidence model and S06 must not synthesize scores.
items.reason_for_deferral: multiple reviewed cases and an explicit confidence design
items.title: Confidence model absent

items.consequence_if_unresolved: Case-local reviewed labels do not authorize a production claim-review workflow.
items.reason_for_deferral: explicit claim-review lifecycle and multiple reviewed cases
items.title: FaultAtlas claim review-state model absent

items.consequence_if_unresolved: These later implementation contracts are real but are outside S06 and depend on S07-S09 decisions and tests.
items.reason_for_deferral: complete P00 decisions and deterministic corpus validation first
items.title: Production loader, migration, and persistence absent

items.consequence_if_unresolved: The bounded invariant remains useful without claiming universal transfer.
items.reason_for_deferral: additional reviewed cross-repository cases
items.title: Cross-repository pattern and transfer not established

items.consequence_if_unresolved: The matrix can calibrate current gaps without becoming a universal production schema.
items.reason_for_deferral: multiple diverse cases and later schema validation
items.title: Single case insufficient for universal schema validation

prerequisites.statement: The S07 decision layer is present and valid.
The S08 legacy compatibility boundary is present and valid.
The S09 corpus tests are green.
The immutable S04-S08 chain is valid.
No production schema is being migrated.
The baseline was clean and synchronized, and final clean synchronization is an external publication condition.
The protected PR workflow is available.

established_findings.statement: Stable repository identity differs from a mutable alias.
Repository-scoped numbers differ from global REST, GraphQL, and node IDs.
Git object identity differs from revision role.
Mutable refs differ from immutable revisions.
Source identity differs from retrieval, acquisition, transformation, interpretation, and publication provenance.
Exact artifact bytes differ from normalized and semantic representations.
Correction is append-only and differs from migration and supersession.
Observed facts, deterministic derivations, reviewed interpretations, hypotheses, unknowns, and unsupported claims are distinct.
Negative or apparently contradictory evidence is first-class and ordered.
Current SourceLocator and ArtifactSnapshot are narrow internal legacy seeds.
A future outer evidence boundary is required but is not implemented by P00.
Deterministic offline replay and package-exclusion validation are feasible and fast.

items.statement: One canonical reference case is selected.
Acquisition and retention policy is published.
Deterministic acquisition procedure is published.
Immutable evidence was acquired and remains exact.
The S04 correction boundary is append-only and established.
The case manifest is published.
Observed and derived relationships are separated.
Negative evidence is first-class and ordered.
The current-contract gap matrix is published.
Identity, revision, and provenance decisions are published.
Snapshot and compatibility decisions are published.
Tracked deterministic corpus tests are published.
Reference corpus and historical LICENSE stay outside packages.
Current internal SourceLocator and ArtifactSnapshot models remain unchanged and provisional.
No external provider reacquisition is required after C01.
No unresolved P00 blocker remains.
Every unresolved semantic or implementation question has a valid later owner.
The roadmap records P00 closure and P01 eligibility without implementation.
The complete isolated repository validation matrix is green.
Protected PR publication with validate, squash, natural main CI, and final synchronization is established.
P00 does not establish universal multi-provider identity.
P00 does not establish private GitHub or GitHub Enterprise behavior.
P00 does not establish non-Git VCS identity.
P00 does not establish a production Evidence Envelope schema.
P00 does not implement production readers, writers, or migration.
P00 does not select persistence technology.
P00 does not implement ingestion.
P00 does not implement retrieval.
P00 does not implement graph storage.
P00 does not establish cross-repository pattern generality.
P00 does not establish transfer scoring.
P00 does not select a model provider.
P00 does not establish an advanced RAG strategy.
